notes: Paper (Dolan et al. 1709.00009) constrains ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a, NOT dark photon kinetic mixing despite the pre-analysis hint - it discusses reinterpreting BaBar dark-photon searches into ALP bounds. Main NEW result is a projected Belle II sensitivity (photon coupling case, gaγZ=0) for single-photon (γ+inv) and three-photon (3γ) searches at 20 fb^-1 and 50 ab^-1, 90% CL. The paper also reviews/updates existing constraints (LEP, SN1987A, E137, E141, HB stars) but these are recompilations of others' work. Data points are rough estimates read from the projected Belle II 3γ (50 ab^-1) curve in figure 7; exact tabulated values are not provided. Values converted from GeV mass to eV (x1e9).
